title: Rivers in the Dry Places
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who keeps looking, and tonight is about seeking and being heard: Isaiah's thirsty people search and find no water until the Lord hears them, and Scout, with an empty bottle and a broken fountain, walks the whole long path until he finds another.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because he keeps looking, and this story is about seeking and being heard. In Scout’s world today: his water bottle runs empty at the park and the fountain is broken. He does not sit down and wail. He walks the whole long path in his bright green shoes until he finds another fountain, low and cold and perfect. Just like the thirsty people Heavenly Father heard, Scout learned that seeking gets answered.
